title: Architecture--Optimization Co-Design for Physics-Informed Neural Networks via Layer-wise Coordinate Adaptation and Gradient Conflict Resolution
abstract: arXiv:2601.12971v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) can be limited by coordinate representations and conflicting gradients from heterogeneous physical constraints. We propose Architecture--Conflict-Resolved PINN (ACR-PINN), combining Layer-wise Dynamic Adaptation (LDA) and Gradient-Conflict-Resolved PINN (GCR-PINN). LDA constructs layer-specific coordinate features and fuses two encoding branches through input-conditioned, feature-wise gates. GCR-PINN treats PDE, initial-condition, and boundary-condition losses as separate tasks and conditionally projects negatively aligned gradients before aggregation, without changing the physical loss formulation. Across seven benchmark problems, ACR-PINN achieves the lowest observed mean across all metrics among four core architecture--optimizer combinations, reducing mean relative $L_2$ error by approximately 56--97\% relative to Std-PINN and improving on the better single-component variant. translated_title: 基于逐层坐标适应与梯度冲突解决的物理信息神经网络架构—优化协同设计
translated_abstract: 物理信息神经网络（PINNs）可能受到坐标表示以及来自异构物理约束的梯度冲突的限制。我们提出了架构—冲突解决PINN（ACR-PINN），结合了逐层动态适应（LDA）和梯度冲突解决PINN（GCR-PINN）。LDA构建层特定的坐标特征，并通过输入条件化的特征级门控机制融合两个编码分支。GCR-PINN将PDE损失、初始条件损失和边界条件损失视为独立任务，并在聚合之前对负对齐的梯度进行有条件的投影，而不改变物理损失的形式。在七个基准问题上，ACR-PINN在四种核心架构—优化器组合中于所有指标上均取得了最低的观测平均值，相对于标准PINN将平均相对L2误差降低了约56%—97%，并且优于表现较好的单组件变体。
tldr: 本文提出ACR-PINN，通过逐层动态适应构建层特定坐标特征，并以梯度投影机制解决PDE、初始与边界条件损失间的梯度冲突，在七个基准问题上较标准PINN将平均相对L2误差降低约56%—97%。
en_tdlr: ACR-PINN co-designs architecture and optimization for physics-informed neural networks by combining layer-wise dynamic coordinate adaptation with conditional projection of gradients conflicting across PDE, initial, and boundary losses, reducing mean relative L2 error by 56–97% over standard PINNs across seven benchmark problems.
